name: fusionaly
description: Ask your analytics from Codex. Bundles the Fusionaly MCP server with the analytics skill.

interface.longDescription: Ask questions about your websites in plain English: where traffic comes from, what changed this week, which pages drive signups. Codex queries your own Fusionaly server through read-only MCP tools. Ask Codex to "connect Fusionaly" first: it verifies your URL and agent key (Administration > Agents) and adds the MCP server.
defaultPrompt: How is my traffic this week compared to last week?
Where do my visitors come from?
What changed on my websites recently?
